register_model: register a model class to the registry using the register_model decorator with a unique name key
register_task: register a task class to the registry using the register_task decorator with a unique name key
register_dataset: register a dataset class to the registry using the register_dataset decorator with a unique name key
get_class: get a registered class from the registry by name and mapping type or full import path
register_state: register an arbitrary key-value pair into the registry state store using dot notation for nested keys
